sources.role: pinned upstream source: README.md, OSBindings/SDL/main.cpp, OSBindings/Mac/Clock Signal/Machine/CSMachine.mm
official platform scope and supported machine list

paths.path: No emulator-owned controller/config file is consumed by the SDL frontend; command-line options are parsed in OSBindings/SDL/main.cpp and machine options are reflected from source objects.
paths.naming: No persisted configuration filename or hand-edited controller grammar is defined by the pinned SDL or Cocoa frontends.

paths.path: The SDL frontend opens every SDL joystick in enumeration order and maps axes 0/1, hats, and raw button indices directly; the macOS frontend has the same direct mapping and marks configurable mapping as TODO.
paths.naming: There is no persisted mapping schema; physical device indices/identifiers must be measured and checked by the same-launch caller.

paths.path: Emulated media files are the persistent artifact (.dsk/.img/.sna depending on machine); no universal sidecar is documented
paths.naming: Emulated media files (.dsk/.img/.sna as applicable) are the persistent artifact; no universal sidecar is documented.

paths.path: The SDL frontend recognizes state snapshots as media in its file-drop path, but the pinned standalone frontends publish no stable user-facing state filename contract.
paths.naming: No stable standalone state filename is documented; do not infer one from internal machine Storage/State classes.

paths.path: Machine ROMs are built-in or machine-specific; where external ROM images are required, the official source does not publish a universal filename/checksum.
paths.naming: Machine ROMs are built-in or machine-specific; no universal external filename/checksum is published.

paths.path: No source-backed keys path or grammar was established for the linux host during this catalog audit.
evidence: source:TomHarte/CLK@096de57445920ecf16cf066979422e34aceb843a (primary source cited by this record; keys capture remains unresolved for linux)

linux.notes: Clock Signal is cycle-accurate and documented for Linux/macOS; Windows/Flatpak native gaps are explicit.
